question: When and where will the 2025 Ballon d’Or ceremony take place?
solution:
p data-end="57" data-start="0">The correct answer is __**September in Paris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ballon d'Or** is the most prestigious individual award in the world of football, and the **2025 ceremony** is scheduled to take place in **September**.
 
• The event will be hosted in **Paris**, **France**, which has served as the traditional home for the "Golden Ball" presentation since its inception.
 
• The **2025** edition marks a significant continuation of the partnership between **France Football** (Groupe Amaury) and **UEFA**, who began co-organizing the gala in **2024**.
 
• The ceremony in **September** will evaluate performances from the **2024-2025 European football season**, focusing on the period from **August** to **July** rather than the calendar year.
